title: Fix nested log filters for primitive values
body:

None.

### Description

Nested log filters can abort a build when a plugin logs a primitive value at an intermediate key. For example, `getLogFilter(['details.kind:visible'])({ details: 'text' })` throws a TypeError.

Treat primitive intermediate values as missing properties. Object and function properties, leaf-value matching, and inverted filters keep their existing behavior. Tests cover primitive values through the public API and mixed log metadata through `--filterLogs`.

Validation:

- Node test suite: 5,446 passed.
- Browser build tests: 12 passed.
- `npm run test:typescript`, `npm run test:package`, and `npm run test:options` passed.
- `npm run lint`, native/WASM builds, and `npm run update:js` passed.

Run the regression tests after building with:

```sh
npm run test:quick -- --grep 'getLogFilter|filter-logs'
```
